title: Sweet Potato Wedges with Crispy Egg White Coating
blurb: Oven-baked sweet potato wedges tossed in olive oil and coated with whisked egg white for an extra-crispy finish.
steps: Heat your oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Line a large baking tray with baking paper.
Scrub the sweet potatoes and cut them into wedges about 2cm thick at the widest part.
Toss the wedges in a bowl with the olive oil, salt and plenty of black pepper until evenly coated.
In a separate small bowl, whisk the egg whites until they become frothy and loose.
Pour the egg whites over the seasoned wedges and toss again so each piece gets a light coating.
Spread the wedges out on the prepared tray in a single layer, leaving space between them.
Bake for 30 minutes, turning them once halfway through, until golden and crisp at the edges.
